description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called 'HomeFragment' which manages a map-based home screen UI including location tracking, destination setting, route drawing, and ride simulation sequences for a ride-hailing app. It integrates Google Maps, geolocation, reverse geocoding, and manages various states related to the ride process.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A StatefulWidget serving as the main container for the map and ride controls.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: State class managing the map, location, markers, ride sequences, and UI interactions.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches current device location with permissions, updates user marker and address, and initializes rider markers.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Performs reverse geocoding on given coordinates to obtain an address string.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Sets up initial rider markers adjacent to user's position.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Constructs the Google Map widget with error handling fallback.

methods.name: _buildMapFallback
methods.description: Provides placeholder UI when Google Maps fails to load.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Handles map camera movement stopping, triggers reverse geocode on new center.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Builds the bottom UI panel with location info and ride actions.

methods.name: _buildRideStatusCard
methods.description: Displays a card indicating current ride status during trip.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens modal bottom sheet for destination input.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of destination, adding markers, drawing route, updating state.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Draws a curved red route polyline between user and destination.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Creates intermediate points for route curve effect.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Adjusts camera bounds to encompass both origin and destination.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates rider approaching by updating marker position over time.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Handles rider arrival event, shows dialog for journey start.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates the ride journey, moving marker and updating status, then navigates to celebration screen.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Resets ride state and navigates to the 'Let’s Celebrate' screen upon completion.
